name: Long Put Ladder (Bear Put Ladder)
summary: Buy 1 higher put, sell 1 middle put, sell 1 lower put; a bear put spread financed by an extra short put, leaving large risk below the bottom strike.

legs.strike_rule: K3 = ATM or slightly ITM, put delta -0.50 to -0.60
K2 = K3 - W, put delta -0.30 to -0.35
K1 = K2 - W, put delta -0.15 to -0.20 (UNCOVERED unless cash-secured)

when_to_use: COMPLETENESS / LEVEL 4 unless the extra short put is fully cash-secured. IV rank > 50 with a target between K1 and K2. Under Level 3 use a put butterfly or put BWB instead.
max_profit: (K3 - K2) x 100 - net debit, flat between K1 and K2
max_loss: very large below K1; treat as UNDEFINED for risk sizing
breakevens: upper = K3 - debit/100; lower = K1 - (K3 - K2) + debit/100

greeks.delta: negative at entry, sharply positive below K1
greeks.theta: positive once spot is below K3

entry_rules: AT LEVEL 3: permitted only if the extra short put is fully cash-secured - reserve K1 x 100 in cash beyond the spread requirement. Otherwise the router must reject it as level 4.
Level 4 version: IV rank >= 50; K1 delta <= -0.20.
Level-3 substitute: buy a fourth put below K1 to form a put condor, or use a put BWB.
management_rules: Close immediately if spot trades below K1.
Close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: two short puts; flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if either short put is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
Close any ITM short put by 2 DTE.
assignment_risk: Assignment on both shorts buys 200 shares per unit, hedged by only 1 long put; the residual is an outright long 100-share position acquired above market during a decline.
buying_power: Spread requirement plus cash-securing for the extra short put (K1 x 100), or naked put margin at Level 4.
common_mistakes: Miscounting legs and running it uncovered at Level 3; being right about direction and still losing because price broke through K1.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
bias_note: moderately bearish with a capped target; short-vol
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
